A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same EPO research work, with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and complete Appendices A–F. All 22 pages in each version support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original EPO experiments on SOTOPIA, WebShop, and ALFWorld, including benchmark results, ablations, self-play analyses, and appendix comparisons.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experiments and analyses, including Tables 1–3, Figures 3–4, and the additional comparison in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 revises the stated trajectory objective and the reward weighting used in the REINFORCE loss. The separate strategic model, frozen interacting agent, process rewards, and iterative self-play remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the implementation changed or the written formulas were corrected.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same SOTOPIA/SOTOPIA-π, WebShop, and ALFWorld coverage, including hard social scenarios, seen/unseen household tasks, and symmetric/asymmetric dialogue interactions.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables and analyses. Describing PPDPP and DAT as RL-trained repeats information already present in v3 Appendix D. The newly mentioned GPRO is an illustrative alternative, not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4.1, Table 5, and Appendix D retain the same splits, sample counts, prompting, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and discount setting of 0.99. The revised on-policy wording restates the self-play procedure already described in v3.

E4.justification: The self-play scaling analysis, collaborative reasoning comparisons, component ablations, single-model SFT comparison, and negotiation case study are retained unchanged in Figures 3–4, Table 3, and Appendices C and F.

E5.justification: Appendix D reports a single run in both versions. Neither version adds or changes seed information, uncertainty estimation, or statistical testing practices.

E6.justification: Table 2 changes EPO-Llama3-8B w/ RL's ALFWorld-Unseen average reward with the Llama3-8B-Instruct interacting agent from 14.5 to 14.2. Other results and comparator rankings are unchanged. The retained '+11.5%' improvement statement no longer matches the revised score and ReAct's 3.0.

T1.justification: Equation (3) replaces a discounted partial return with an undiscounted full-trajectory sum. The per-turn return changes from sum_{t'=t}^T gamma^(T-t') r_{t'} to r_t + sum_{i=1}^T gamma^i r_{t+i}, and gamma's domain changes from [0,1) to (0,1]. These are non-equivalent mathematical revisions; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions and claims concerning modular strategic reasoning, multi-turn RL, transferability, benchmark superiority, collaborative mechanisms, and novel strategies.

C2.justification: The interpretations of collaborative behavior, transferability, and component effectiveness remain unchanged, as do Appendix C's ALFWorld weakness and the stated limitations. The revised on-policy wording does not establish a new applicability boundary.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the promise to release models and code with a statement that code and data are available through an EPO repository hyperlink. This adds concrete access information; repository contents cannot be verified from the supplied PDFs. Implementation details and prompts are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: v5 adds Shao et al.'s DeepSeekMath reference and replaces Section 3.2's offline DPO example with 'GPRO' as printed. Rafailov et al. remains cited elsewhere. An additional Song et al. citation attributes the retained average-reward metric; overall research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: Localized edits revise the RL explanation, clarify baseline descriptions, use the EPO-SFT label, and update author/contact and availability text. The section sequence, narrative, and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The author block gains email lines, and equation/text revisions alter column and page breaks. All four figures are identical, and table structures and captions remain unchanged. Table 2's numerical update is a result change, not a display redesign.

improvement.justification: The new repository link improves access information, but the mathematical revision has mixed implications: future discounting is explicit, while summing r_{t+i} through i=T leaves rewards beyond the stated terminal turn unspecified. Table 2's revision also creates a mismatch with the retained '+11.5%' claim. Without explaining how the revised formulas relate to the reported experiments, these benefits and reporting ambiguities do not establish a reliable net quality improvement.
